question: Does the N=32 picture of declining width — rich 2×2 intact, lazy matched-loss failing, GLUE packed but signs intact — continue at N=16, where P/N=1 and P(D+1)/N=5?
why: The small-n grid at N=32/100 showed richness keeping CF and Δ log α signs organised like N=300, while lazy S-HH CF broke and N=32 D_eff collapsed to ~1.22. N=16 is one more octave down: module width equals P, concatenated readout is 32 parameters, packing is 5× worse than N=32. This is to read the capacity decline, not to enter the paper. Same 2×2, same 8 seeds, same stream, same two γ. N=32 and N=100 are not retrained.
sampling_unit: initialisation, one arrangement (stream_id=0). Same unit as the N=32/100 grid. Not pooled with N=300.

statistics.same_as_small_n_grid: CF, past-task accuracy, Δ log α (task 0, lag 15, module A), Δρ_c, D_eff generic at boundary 0, n_usable. Unusable arms stay in the means.
statistics.init_readout: Frozen-W module-A and A+B exact-readout MSE at N=16, 33 dichotomies, written beside the arms before training.

decision_rule.rich_CF_2x2_survives: γ=10: mean CF(S-HH) ≤ 0.01 AND mean CF(S-HL) ≥ 0.25 AND CF order S-HL > S-LL > S-LH > S-HH. Same rule as N=32/100.
decision_rule.rich_CF_2x2_breaks: γ=10: mean CF(S-HH) ≥ 0.05 OR mean CF(S-HL) < 0.20 OR that order fails.
decision_rule.rich_fit_breaks: γ=10 S-HH n_usable < 4 of 8. Then even the rich arm cannot match loss 0.05; N=16 is past the training object, not just past GLUE packing. Report loss-at-cap, do not treat CF as matched-loss.
decision_rule.glue_signs_match: γ=10: mean Δ log α > 0 on S-HH and < 0 on the other three. Magnitudes and channel shares are not a pass/fail. Packing is expected (D_eff < 2).
decision_rule.lazy_expected_unusable: γ=0.03: most tasks will miss 0.05. That is a predicted floor, not a CF finding. Still report CF, flagged by n_usable.
decision_rule.capacity_decline: Descriptive: mean retained α at boundary 0 and lag 15, and D_eff, versus N=32/100 on the same stream. No threshold. The point of this run.

can_show: whether the rich 2×2 and GLUE signs survive one more octave of width, and how retained α / D_eff move from N=32 to N=16 on this arrangement
reporting: Same directory as N=32/100 so analyse_small_n_grid.py sees all three widths. Off-design. Score after the 64 complete.
